title: Cut Susi 0.21.49: bump the engine version and hand the tagged build to release.yml
goal: Release main as 0.21.49. The v0.21.48 tag (71633e121) never published: its tagged suite failed gmcp_requirements mastery checks on stale VC-203 evidence, and a tag cannot be moved. Main has since re-recorded the evidence and its root-cli shards are green. Bump the seven engine-version manifests, Cargo.lock, the README badge and the three governance ledgers together (matching 4bf339c84), re-record the VC-203 evidence the bump stales, and let the merge bot tag v0.21.49 and dispatch release.yml, which publishes the windows-x86_64 and linux-x86_64 binaries. Installed Windows production promotion is a separate, evidence-gated step and is not claimed by this cut.
